description: Media containing Controlled Unclassified Information is not properly marked or labeled. This signal indicates that CUI media may not be identifiable, leading to improper handling or protection.
applicability: Applicable to all media containing CUI. Includes physical labels, file headers, container markings, and any identification mechanisms for CUI-containing media.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through media labeling review, marking standard compliance assessment, and CUI identification verification.
